Welcome from Mr Scott McGuinness - Head Teacher
A History of excellence underpins the progressive nature of our school
Emerson Park Academy creates well-rounded individuals who excel in the arts, academically and on the sporting field. First-class teaching and the continual drive for excellence are the cornerstones of our practice.
There is something unique about an education at Emerson Park Academy.
The secondary school journey is full of excitement, opportunity and wonder. We would be delighted and proud should you take this journey with us.
Head Boy and Girl Welcome
As Head Girl and Boy of Emerson Park Academy, it is our job to promote our academy and inform any future pupils and their parents of the incredible opportunities that await them.
Over the last four years we have seen the school progress academically and we are proud to represent the school. Our motto is Endeavour Persevere Achieve and our pupils strive to abide by this. From the extra-curricular activities, to the dedicated teachers and assistants, Emerson Park Academy offers many benefits that pupils can take advantage of.

General information
About Us
Emerson Park Academy is a mixed comprehensive academy for pupils aged 11–16. Pupils are organised into year-group tutor groups, with each year group supported by a dedicated Head of Year and Assistant Head of Year. In addition, all students belong to one of four Houses: Brunel, Cavell, Hepworth, or Redgrave. Each house has two form groups within every year group, fostering a strong sense of community and belonging.
The Academy benefits from a full complement of committed, highly qualified specialist teachers and support staff. We are fortunate to have such a talented and hardworking workforce, whose dedication helps ensure that every student receives the support and opportunities they need to succeed.
Our ethos and values centre on supporting students holistically. We build upon prior learning, nurture individual potential, and prepare young people for the opportunities and challenges of the future. We encourage all students to strive for excellence, be the best they can be, and make a positive contribution to both the school and the wider community.
We place great importance on traditional values of behaviour, appearance, and courtesy. Good manners, respect for others, and considerate conduct are fundamental expectations within our school community, helping to create a positive, disciplined, and supportive learning environment for all.
General information

Curriculum
The Emerson Park Academy curriculum aims to offer a broad balance of essential and wider experiences so that each pupil can find something they enjoy and something in which they can succeed. We provide an inclusive range of opportunities, engaging with every pupil to achieve their full potential in a learning culture that is challenging, stimulating, inspirational and enjoyable.

Vaping
Please see the attached PDF for information about the impact of Vaping on young people.
THC Sweets
It has come to our notice that THC sweets have become popular across the UK with teenagers, and are unfortunately easily available online. They look like harmless sweets but they are in fact laced with THC – the psychoactive ingredient in cannabis. 13 school children in London have been hospitalised after eating them. Here is a photo so that you know what to look for.
We know reporting crime is never easy, but at fearless.org your identity remains completely unknown which might may the process that bit easier.
Please find below the website link for Fearless. This is linked to Crimestoppers but specifically aimed at young people. Information can be provided anonymously.
https://crimestoppers-uk.org/fearless
Also, the link for immobilise below. We would encourage young people to register mobile phones on this database however anything with a serial number or of high value can be registered. Police use this to check any property recovered to see if an owner can be identified.
https://www.immobilise.com/

Extra-Curricular
At Emerson Park Academy, we encourage students to take part in the many and varied extra-curricular activities that we offer. Taking part in the extra-curricular life of the school offers students the opportunity to learn new skills, develop talents and make new friends. Please click on the links attached to this page for more details.
A variety of trips are offered every year such as: universities, language trips, geography field trips, history tours and global links trips.
